│ layout                       panes                   workspaces            │
│            ←↓↑→ focus               t new pane           1-0 workspace     │
│      shift+←↓↑→ resize              q close          alt+1-0 send pane     │
│ ctrl+shift+←↓↑→ move                w float          ctrl+←→ prev/next     │
│        alt+←↓↑→ split there         f next float      ctrl+↓ empty one     │
│               j split dir    ctrl+h/l prev/next tab        . rename        │
│               = equalize            , rename               s scratchpad    │
│           alt+⏎ fullscreen          a sync input       alt+s to scratchpad │
│               M swap master         A unsync all                           │
│             spc next layout                                                │
╰ +plugins · yours · sessions · history · ranma ──────────────── ? all keys ─╯
